healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the ClickUp personal API token by calling GET /v2/user. Takes no input and returns the connector health status with the authenticated user's ID.

workspaces.list.title: List Workspaces
workspaces.list.description: List the ClickUp Workspaces (called Teams in the API) the token can access. Every other operation needs a workspace, space, folder, or list ID, so this is the entry point for discovering the hierarchy.

spaces.list.title: List Spaces
spaces.list.description: List the Spaces in a ClickUp Workspace. A Space is the top level of the hierarchy below the Workspace and contains Folders and Lists.

archived.description: Include archived Spaces. Defaults to false.

folders.list.title: List Folders
folders.list.description: List the Folders in a ClickUp Space. Subfolders are returned in the same flat list, each carrying a parent_folder field naming the Folder it is nested inside.

archived.description: Include archived Folders. Defaults to false.

lists.list.title: List Lists In Folder
lists.list.description: List the ClickUp Lists inside a Folder. Lists that live directly in a Space rather than a Folder are returned by List Folderless Lists instead.

archived.description: Include archived Lists. Defaults to false.

lists.list-folderless.title: List Folderless Lists
lists.list-folderless.description: List the ClickUp Lists that sit directly in a Space rather than inside a Folder. A Space's Lists are split across this operation and List Lists In Folder, so discovering every List in a Space needs both.

archived.description: Include archived Lists. Defaults to false.

lists.get.title: Get List
lists.get.description: Fetch one ClickUp List by ID, including its available statuses, assignee, and the Folder and Space it belongs to.

lists.create.title: Create List
lists.create.description: Create a ClickUp List inside a Folder.

folderId.description: Folder ID the List is created in.

dueDate.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

assignee.description: User ID to assign the List to.

tasks.list.title: List Tasks In List
tasks.list.description: List the tasks whose home List is the given ClickUp List. Returns at most 100 tasks per page; read further pages with the page input. Closed tasks are excluded unless includeClosed is set.

page.description: Zero-based page number. 100 tasks per page.

orderBy.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to created.

assignees.description: Only tasks assigned to these user IDs.

dueDateGt.description: Only tasks due after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

dueDateLt.description: Only tasks due before this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

tasks.search.title: Search Workspace Tasks
tasks.search.description: Search tasks across an entire ClickUp Workspace, optionally narrowed to given Spaces, Folders, or Lists. Use this when the List is not known; use List Tasks In List when it is. Returns at most 100 tasks per page.

assignees.description: Only tasks assigned to these user IDs.

dueDateGt.description: Only tasks due after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

dueDateLt.description: Only tasks due before this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Fetch one ClickUp task by ID, including its status, assignees, custom fields, and the List, Folder, and Space it belongs to.

customTaskIds.description: Treat taskId as a custom task ID. Requires teamId.

teamId.description: Workspace ID. Required when customTaskIds is true.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Create a task in a ClickUp List. Only the name is required. Set parent to create a subtask of an existing task.

listId.description: List ID the task is created in.

markdownContent.description: Markdown task description. Takes precedence over description.

status.description: Status name, which must be one the List defines.

dueDate.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

startDate.description: Start date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parent.description: Task ID this task becomes a subtask of.

notifyAll.description: Notify every assignee of the change.

tasks.update.title: Update Task
tasks.update.description: Update a ClickUp task. Only the fields supplied are changed; everything else is left alone. Changing assignees is not exposed here because ClickUp takes an add/remove pair for that field rather than a list.

status.description: New status name, which must be one the List defines.

dueDate.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

startDate.description: Start date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parent.description: Task ID to nest this task under.

tasks.delete.title: Delete Task
tasks.delete.description: Permanently delete a ClickUp task. The API returns no body on success.

comments.list.title: List Task Comments
comments.list.description: List a ClickUp task's comments, newest first. Returns the 25 most recent by default; read older pages by passing the start and startId of the oldest comment in the current page.

start.description: Date of the oldest comment in the current page, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Must be sent with startId.

startId.description: ID of the oldest comment in the current page. Must be sent with start.

comments.create.title: Create Task Comment
comments.create.description: Post a comment on a ClickUp task. notifyAll is required by the API: set it false to comment without notifying every assignee.

notifyAll.description: Notify every assignee. Required by ClickUp; pass false for a quiet comment.

assignee.description: User ID to assign the comment to.

time-entries.start.title: Start Time Entry
time-entries.start.description: Start a running ClickUp timer in a Workspace, optionally attached to a task. Only one timer runs per user at a time; starting another stops the previous one.

taskId.description: Task ID to track time against.

time-entries.stop.title: Stop Time Entry
time-entries.stop.description: Stop the ClickUp timer currently running for the authenticated user in a Workspace.

members.list.title: List Workspace Members
members.list.description: List the members of a ClickUp Workspace (Team). Use List Workspaces to discover team IDs.

webhook.taskCreated.title: Task Created
webhook.taskCreated.description: Inbound ClickUp webhook for the taskCreated event (Composio trigger CLICKUP_TASK_CREATED). Receiving the event does not call the ClickUp API.

webhook.taskUpdated.title: Task Updated
webhook.taskUpdated.description: Inbound ClickUp webhook for the taskUpdated event (Composio trigger CLICKUP_TASK_UPDATED). Receiving the event does not call the ClickUp API.

webhook.taskCommentPosted.title: Task Comment Posted
webhook.taskCommentPosted.description: Inbound ClickUp webhook for the taskCommentPosted event (Composio trigger CLICKUP_TASK_COMMENT_POSTED). Receiving the event does not call the ClickUp API.

time-entries.current.title: Get Running Time Entry
time-entries.current.description: Fetch the ClickUp timer currently running in a Workspace, for the authenticated user or for another user by ID.

assignee.description: User ID whose running timer to read. Defaults to the authenticated user.

Use [Get Custom Task Types](ref:getcustomitems) to resolve IDs to names. Fields without task-type scoping omit `applied_objects`. Workspace-scoped Custom Fields are in…

include_applied_objects.description: When `true`, includes `applied_objects` on task-type-scoped Custom Fields in the response.

custom-fields.create.title: Set Custom Field Value
custom-fields.create.description: Add data to a Custom field on a task. \ \ You'll need to know the `task_id` of the task you want to update, and the universal unique identifier (UUID) `field_id` of the Custom Field you want to set. \ \ The Custom Field must be applicable to the task's current `custom_item_id`. Use [Get Custom Fields](ref:getaccessiblecustomfields) (check each field's `applied_objects`) or [Get Task](ref:gettask) to find applicable `field_id` values.\ \ Returns `400` if the field is not e…

task_id.description: Enter the task ID of the task you want to update.

field_id.description: Enter the universal unique identifier (UUID) of the Custom Field you want to set.

custom_task_ids.description: If you want to reference a task by its Custom Task ID, this value must be `true`.

team_id.description: When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. \ For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

value.description: Custom Field value. Text, email, phone, URL, and dropdown option IDs are strings. Numbers, currency, and ratings are numbers. Checkboxes are booleans. Labels are arrays of option IDs. Users, tasks, locations, and manual progress are objects. Dates are Unix timestamps in milliseconds.

value_options.description: Optional field settings. Date fields use {"time": true}. Currency fields use {"currency_type": "USD"}.

custom-fields.delete.description: Remove the data from a Custom Field on a task. This does not delete the option from the Custom Field

folders.create.title: Create Folder
folders.create.description: Add a new Folder to a Space. You can optionally create the Folder as a subfolder within an existing Folder by providing `parent_folder_id` in the request body. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace

parent_folder_id.description: ID of an existing Folder to create this Folder inside of as a subfolder. The parent Folder must belong to the same Space specified in the path. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace.

folders.get.title: Get Folder
folders.get.description: View the Lists within a Folder. If the Folder is a subfolder, the response includes a `parent_folder` field with the parent Folder ID. Use the `include_subfolders` query parameter to include a `folders` array in the response. Each entry is a complete Folder object with the same fields as the Folder you requested, including its own `folders` array, so the response contains the whole subfolder tree down to the Workspace's subfolder nesting limit. Subfolders the requesting user cannot a…

include_subfolders.description: Set to `true` to include the nested subfolder tree in the response as a `folders` array of complete Folder objects. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace.

folders.update.title: Update Folder
folders.update.description: Rename a Folder. Renaming a subfolder leaves it nested inside its parent Folder, and the response includes the `parent_folder` field. This endpoint only renames a Folder. To nest a Folder inside another Folder or move it to another Space, use the [Move Folder](#tag/Folders/operation/MoveFolder) endpoint; a `parent_folder_id` sent to this endpoint is ignored

folders.delete.title: Delete Folder
folders.delete.description: Delete a Folder from your Workspace

folders.update-position.title: Move Folder
folders.update-position.description: Move a Folder, either by nesting it inside another Folder as a subfolder or by moving it to another Space as a top-level Folder. Provide `parent_folder_id` to nest the Folder inside another Folder, or `space_id` to move it to another Space as a top-level Folder. If both are provided, `parent_folder_id` takes precedence and `space_id` is ignored, so the Folder inherits the Space of its new parent Folder. Use `position` to control placement among siblings in the destination; the Folde…

parent_folder_id.description: ID of the Folder to nest this Folder inside of, making it a subfolder. The destination Folder must be in the same Workspace. Subfolder support must be enabled for the Workspace.

space_id.description: ID of the Space to move this Folder to as a top-level Folder. Ignored when `parent_folder_id` is also provided, in which case the Folder inherits the Space of its new parent Folder.

position.description: Position of the Folder among its siblings in the destination. Defaults to the top of the destination when omitted.

custom_type_map.description: Map of task type IDs in the Folder to the task type IDs to use after the move, as `{"<source_type_id>": <destination_type_id>}`. Required when moving to a destination where a task type used in the Folder is unavailable.

auditlogs.create.description: Create Workspace-level audit logs. Only the Workspace owner can create audit logs. \ \ ***Note:** This endpoint is only available to Workspaces on our [Enterprise Plan](https://clickup.com/pricing).*

applicability.description: Type of logs to filter by. Options include `auth-and-security`, `custom-fields`, `hierarchy-activity` and `user-activity`. Most use cases will use `auth-and-security`.

comments.list-subtypes.title: Get Post Subtype IDs
comments.list-subtypes.description: Get the ID of each post subtype (Announcement, Discussion, Idea, and Update) for your Workspace, to use when [sending a message](https://developer.clickup.com/reference/createchatmessage) with `type: post`. \ \ Subtype IDs are unique to each Workspace

workspace_id.description: ID of the logged-in user's Workspace.

docs.list.title: Search for Docs
docs.list.description: View the Docs in your Workspace. You can only view information of Docs you can access

id.description: Filter results to Docs created by the user with the given Doc ID.

creator.description: Filter results to Docs created by the user with the given user ID.

deleted.description: Filter results to return deleted Docs.

archived.description: Filter results to return archived Docs.

parent_id.description: Filter results to children of a parent Doc with the given parent Doc ID.

parent_type.description: Filter results to children of the given parent Doc type. For example, `SPACE`, `FOLDER`, `LIST`, `EVERYTHING`, `WORKSPACE`.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to fetch for this page.

cursor.description: The cursor to use to fetch the next page of results.

next_cursor.description: The cursor to use to fetch the next page of results. [deprecated]

name.description: The name of the new Doc.

visibility.description: The visibility of the new Doc. For example, `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`.

create_page.description: Create a new page when creating the Doc.

docs.list-page-listing.title: Fetch PageListing for a Doc
docs.list-page-listing.description: View the PageListing for a Doc

max_page_depth.description: The maximum depth to retrieve pages and subpages. Use `-1` to return pages and subpages with no depth limit.

docs.list-pages.title: Fetch Pages belonging to a Doc
docs.list-pages.description: View the pages belonging to a Doc

max_page_depth.description: The maximum depth to retrieve pages and subpages. Use `-1` to return pages and subpages with no depth limit.

content_format.description: The format to return the page content in. For example, `text/md` for markdown or `text/plain` for plain text.

docs.create-pages.title: Create a Page
docs.create-pages.description: Create a page in a Doc

parent_page_id.description: The ID of the parent page. If this is a root page in the Doc, `parent_page_id` will not be returned.

name.description: The name of the new page.

sub_title.description: The subtitle of the new page.

content.description: The content of the new page.

content_format.description: The format the page content is in. For example, `text/md` for markdown or `text/plain` for plain text.

docs.get-pages.title: Get page
docs.get-pages.description: View the information about a page in a Doc. Due to markdown format limitations, some content elements [will not be displayed exactly as they appear in ClickUp](doc:docsimportexportlimitations/)

content_format.description: The format to return the page content in. For example, `text/md` for markdown or `text/plain` for plain text.

docs.update.title: Edit a Page
docs.update.description: Edit a page in a Doc

name.description: The updated name of the page.

sub_title.description: The updateds ubtitle of the page.

content.description: The updated content of the page.

content_edit_mode.description: The strategy for updating content on the page. For example, `replace`, `append`, or `prepend`.

content_format.description: The format the page content is in. For example, `text/md` for markdown or `text/plain` for plain text.

tasks.update-home-list.title: Move a task to a new List
tasks.update-home-list.description: Move a task to a new List. For Tasks in Multiple Lists, this endpoint only moves the task to a new home List. [Learn more](doc:move-a-task-to-a-new-list) about the options available when moving a task to a new List

task_id.description: The ID of the requested Task.

list_id.description: The ID of the List to move the task to.

move_custom_fields.description: Add Custom Fields from the current List to the new List.

custom_fields_to_move.description: An array of Custom Fields IDs to move. This parameter is not required to move all Custom Fields to the new List.

status_mappings.description: Map the current List statuses to the statuses in the new List. You only need to include the ID of the task's current status and the ID of it's new status. **Note:** This parameter is required if the task's current status is not available in the new List.

tasks.update-time-estimates-by-user.title: Update task time estimates by user
tasks.update-time-estimates-by-user.description: Replace the time estimates on a task for specified assignees. Assignees must be currently assigned to the task, or use `assignee: unassigned` to set a time estimates for unassigned work. You can set up to 10 estimates per request. ***Note:** This endpoint is only available on our Business Plan or above.*

task_id.description: The ID of the task. This parameter supports task IDs and Custom task IDs.

tasks.update-time-estimates-by-user-2.title: Replace task time estimates
tasks.update-time-estimates-by-user-2.description: Replaces all time estimates for a task with the provided time estimates. Any existing time estimates not included in the request will be removed. Assignees must be currently assigned to the task, or use `assignee: unassigned` to set a time estimates for unassigned work. You can set up to 10 estimates per request. ***Note:** This endpoint is only available on our Business Plan or above.*

task_id.description: The ID of the task. This parameter supports task IDs and Custom task IDs.

oauth.get-access-token.title: Get Access Token
oauth.get-access-token.description: Exchange a ClickUp OAuth 2.0 authorization code for an access token. Sends client_id, client_secret, and code as query parameters on POST /api/v2/oauth/token.

client_id.description: Client ID of the registered ClickUp OAuth app.

client_secret.description: Client secret of the registered ClickUp OAuth app.

code.description: Authorization code from the ClickUp consent redirect.

data.description: Raw ClickUp JSON response, including access_token.
